title: Roswell/Corona crash confirmed via Ed Mitchell and Admiral Wilson
summary: Eric Davis tells of Roswell/Corona crash confirmed via Ed Mitchell and Admiral Wilson, about 1947 at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I had my uh information I got from Ed Mitchell at a science advisory board meeting about the Greer briefings on the disclosure project at at the Pentagon and then Admiral Wilson coming back and verifying that the Roswell crash well the Corona crash actually really did happen. It wasn't a mogul balloon.

plain: A scientist who has worked with the Pentagon, Eric Davis, says that at a science advisory meeting he heard from Ed Mitchell, an astronaut, about briefings the Pentagon got from Steven Greer, who ran the Disclosure Project, a campaign to get officials to speak about UFOs. According to Davis, a Navy admiral, Thomas Wilson, then came back and confirmed that the 1947 crash near Corona, New Mexico, usually called Roswell, really happened and was not a secret high-altitude spy balloon, as the official explanation says. If true, it would mean a senior officer confirmed a real crash of something unknown.
